Name: IDigWhereIWant
Author: WillTheMage
Description:
[b]IDigWhereIWant[/b]

This mod allows you to dig wherever your cursor is positioned!
As long as it's possible to dig there, it won't break rocks...

I'm playing the game right now, I'll soon play and create mods for other games, so I can't keep updating this mod.

I only tested it on version 1.6 which I'm currently playing.

My other mod if you are interested: [b][Auto Catch Fish Mod][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25997/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25997/[/url]
My other mod if you are interested: [b][BombDropMod][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26062/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26062/[/url]
My other mod if you are interested: [b][WateringCanUpgrade][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25977/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25977/[/url]
My other mod if you are interested: [b][IDigWhereIWant][/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26063/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26063/[/url]


[youtube]-yA9kbJlRCI[/youtube]


[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
